title: Ruined Goddess with Black Hole
description: A stone statue of a bare-chested woman with glowing blue flames for eyes and hair sits inside a broken circular stone structure covered in green vines. Two large black birds fly near a massive black hole with a red fiery ring in a dark red sky while a third bird flies lower; broken stone pillars, scattered carved stones with paint marks, and glowing blue liquid appear in the foreground.
